prompt: I have a small WinForms app in this folder (TaskBoard). I want to hand it to a few testers as an MSIX installer. Please build it and install it on this machine the same way a tester would, so I can confirm it actually installs and launches.

reference.approach: Publish the app, generate a package manifest, pack it into an .msix, sign it with a certificate this machine trusts, and install the .msix file itself (not a loose-folder registration).

checks: installed-from-msix (required): it was installed from the package archive, not registered from a loose folder (IsDevelopmentMode is false)
msix-built (required): an .msix or .msixbundle exists under the project folder
msix-signed (required): it carries an Authenticode signature that still matches the file
msix-trusted: the signature chain is trusted on this machine
installed (required): a new package whose application runs TaskBoard.exe is installed for the user
installed-matches-msix: the installed package has the identity of the built .msix
launches (required): activating the installed app starts TaskBoard.exe from the package
